node.title: Re^6: getting rid of UTF-8
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I did the $line =~ s/\xef\xbb\xbf// and it didn't remove the characters!

Using the advice from [kcott] [id://11148373|here] to use /g, it works for me. If it really doesn't work for you, then perhaps the data you have in your Perl string is not what you think it is. See my node [id://1233709|here] for advice on how to show us the real data, in particular [doc://Devel::Peek], and make sure to provide an [id://1177642|SSCCE] that we can run to see the problem for ourselves.
